description: Flowise AgentFlow v2 workflow patterns, best practices, and anti-patterns for Context Codex integration

anthropic.description: Default settings for ChatAnthropic model in AgentFlow nodes

openai.description: Default settings for ChatOpenAI model in AgentFlow nodes

v2_2_agent_structure.description: CRITICAL: Use this exact structure for all v2.2 agent nodes
key_differences_from_older_versions: agentModelConfig is nested object with credential, modelName, temperature, streaming, and agentModel
agentStateUpdates (NOT updateState) is array of {key, value} objects
agentSelectedToolConfig is nested inside each tool object
agentMessages can be empty string or array of messages

patterns.description: Sequential processing pipeline with artifact handoffs between agents

node_structure.topology: Start → Chain1 → HIL Gate → Chain2 → Chain3 → Report

implementation_notes: Each chain agent outputs artifacts consumed by next agent
Use state variables to track pipeline progress with updateState
HIL gates placed between critical stages for human review
Final agent aggregates all artifacts into report
All agents must have complete inputParams array (15+ fields)
testing_checklist: Verify Start node has formTitle, formDescription, formInputTypes
Verify each agent receives previous agent's output via state
Test HIL gate approval and rejection paths
Validate final output contains all pipeline artifacts
Check all agents have complete inputParams arrays

patterns.description: Multi-source research with parallel execution and result aggregation

node_structure.topology: Start → [Web Search || KB || Analyzer] → Aggregator → Report

implementation_notes: Start node fans out to multiple parallel agents
Each parallel agent works independently on same input
Aggregator waits for all parallel agents to complete
Use state to collect results from each branch
Aggregator synthesizes insights from all sources
use_cases: Competitive analysis from multiple data sources
testing_checklist: Verify all parallel branches receive same input
Verify aggregator receives all branch outputs
Test timeout handling for slow branches
Validate synthesized output includes all sources

patterns.description: Intent-based routing using ConditionAgent for request classification
implementation_notes: ConditionAgent must have complete scenarios array with {scenario, model, instructions, input}
Router temperature should be low (0.1-0.3) for deterministic decisions
Number of scenarios MUST equal number of downstream agents
Each scenario routes to exactly one specialized agent
Include clarification and error handling scenarios
CRITICAL: Use Synthesizer agent as TERMINAL node - all domain agents connect to Synthesizer, NO DirectReply after it
CRITICAL: Synthesizer must have agentEnableMemory: true or it throws 'at least one message is required' error
NEVER use || syntax in DirectReply (e.g., {{ var1 || var2 }}) - returns literal string, not resolved value
Agent nodes without outgoing edges return their response directly to user
Synthesizer reads from $flow.state to find which domain agent's response was populated
testing_checklist: Verify Start node connects to ConditionAgent
Test each scenario routes to correct agent
Verify scenarios array has complete structure
Test ambiguous inputs route to clarification
Validate error handling catches invalid requests

patterns.description: Quality refinement loop with planning, research, and iterative improvement

node_structure.topology: Start → Planner → Gate → Research → [loop back to Planner]

implementation_notes: Planner agent creates initial plan
Gate decides if more iteration needed
Research agent gathers additional information
Loop continues until quality threshold met
Use state to track iteration count and results
testing_checklist: Verify loop terminates after max iterations

patterns.description: Validation-driven retry loop with generation, validation, and conditional retry

node_structure.topology: Start → Generate → Validate → Gate → [PASS | FIX | FAIL]

implementation_notes: Generator creates initial output
Validator checks output against criteria
Gate routes based on validation result
FIX path returns to generator with feedback
Track retry count in state to prevent infinite loops
testing_checklist: Test PASS path with valid output
Test FIX path with fixable errors
Test FAIL path with unfixable errors
Verify retry count prevents infinite loops
Validate feedback passed to generator on retry

patterns.description: Task delegation with supervisor orchestrating worker agents
implementation_notes: Supervisor breaks down complex task into subtasks
Checker validates subtask definitions
Workers execute individual subtasks
Reviewer validates worker outputs
Supervisor aggregates results into final output
testing_checklist: Test checker rejects invalid task definitions
Verify final aggregation includes all subtask outputs

patterns.description: Array processing with iteration node for batch operations

node_structure.topology: Start → Planner → Iteration Node → Processor (N times) → Aggregator

implementation_notes: Planner splits input into array of items
Iteration node processes each item through processor
Processor handles single item at a time
Aggregator collects all processed results
Use state to track progress through array

patterns.description: Score-based validation with conditional retry based on quality threshold

node_structure.topology: Generator → Validator → Condition (score check) → [PASS | RETRY | FAIL]

implementation_notes: Validator outputs numeric score
Condition node checks score against threshold
PASS (score >= threshold), RETRY (score < threshold && retries < max)
FAIL (retries >= max)
Include feedback in retry loop
testing_checklist: Test PASS with score above threshold
Test RETRY with score below threshold
Verify score correctly extracted from validator

patterns.description: External HTTP API integration with status-based error handling
implementation_notes: Extractor prepares API request payload from user input
Custom HTTP tool makes external API call
Condition routes based on HTTP status code
200: Process response normally
5xx: Retry with exponential backoff
4xx: Return user-friendly error message

patterns.description: Document Q&A with retrieval-augmented generation and citations

node_structure.topology: Query Analyzer → Retriever → Generator LLM → Formatter

implementation_notes: Query analyzer rewrites user question for better retrieval
Retriever fetches relevant documents from vector store
Generator LLM synthesizes answer from retrieved context
Formatter adds citations and source references
Include confidence scoring for answer quality
testing_checklist: Test with question that has clear answer
Test with question requiring multiple sources
Test with question with no relevant docs

patterns.description: Cost optimization pattern routing simple queries to tools vs complex to LLM
implementation_notes: Parser classifies query complexity (simple arithmetic vs complex reasoning)
Simple queries route to Calculator tool (cheap, fast)
Complex queries route to LLM agent (expensive, powerful)
Reduces API costs for straightforward operations
Use low-cost model for parser (e.g., Haiku)
testing_checklist: Test simple arithmetic routes to tool
Test complex reasoning routes to LLM
Verify cost savings over all-LLM approach
Validate tool outputs match LLM for simple cases

patterns.description: RAG with confidence-based routing for high vs low relevance answers
implementation_notes: Retriever fetches candidate documents
Relevance checker scores document relevance (0-1)
High confidence (>= 0.7): Answer directly from docs
Low confidence (< 0.7): Escalate to human or request clarification
Prevents hallucination by not answering with low-relevance context

patterns.description: ETL pipeline with extraction, validation, and conditional processing
implementation_notes: Extractor parses input data (JSON, CSV, etc.)
Validator checks data against schema/rules
Valid data proceeds to transformation/loading
Invalid data routes to error handling
Track validation errors in state for reporting

common_issues.description: Agent nodes missing inputParams array, preventing UI editability in Flowise
symptoms: Agent node appears in workflow but cannot be edited
Double-clicking agent node does nothing
Node configuration panel is blank or shows errors
Tools and memory settings not visible in UI
common_issues.root_cause: Builder omitted inputParams array from agent node data structure. Without this array, Flowise UI cannot render the node's configuration form.
common_issues.solution: Every agent node MUST include complete inputParams array with 15+ fields matching AGENT-NODE-TEMPLATE.json
prevention: Use AGENT-NODE-TEMPLATE.json as reference for all agent nodes
Validate inputParams array presence in Test phase
Check inputParams count >= 15 fields
Never omit inputParams even if using default values

common_issues.description: Builder outputs meta-description instead of complete workflow JSON
symptoms: Generated JSON is only 100-200 lines instead of 1000+
Nodes contain description text instead of actual configuration
systemMessage contains 'This agent handles...' instead of actual prompts
Workflow imports but has no functional agents
common_issues.root_cause: Flowise extension not properly activated for new projects, causing Builder to output planning description instead of implementation
common_issues.solution: Ensure flowise_flow: True in CONFIGURATION. Builder must output actual node structures, not descriptions of what nodes should do.
prevention: Verify flowise_flow: True in Scout phase
Check JSON file size (should be 1000+ lines for typical workflow)
Validate systemMessage contains actual instructions
Test import into Flowise and verify agents respond

common_issues.description: Builder creates separate config files instead of single workflow JSON
symptoms: Multiple JSON files created (agent-configs/, tool-configs/, etc.)
Main workflow JSON references external files that don't exist
Import fails with 'file not found' errors
Modular architecture that Flowise cannot interpret
common_issues.root_cause: Misunderstood 'modular architecture' as separate files. Flowise requires ALL nodes, edges, and configurations in a single JSON file.
common_issues.solution: Disable parallel mode for Flowise builds. All agents, tools, and connections must be inline in one JSON file.
prevention: Set parallel_mode: false in build-tasks.json for Flowise projects
Verify only one JSON file in output directory
Check all node definitions are inline
Validate no external file references in workflow

common_issues.description: Tool configuration uses wrong field names causing import failures
symptoms: Flowise crashes on import
Tools not appearing in agent configuration
Error: 'agentSelectedTool' is not a valid tool
Custom HTTP tools failing to execute
common_issues.root_cause: Using incorrect field names (baseUrl instead of apiBase, toolName with wrong casing)
common_issues.solution: Use EXACT field names from Flowise UI exports. Tool names are case-sensitive.
common_issues.code_fix:
// WRONG:
"agentSelectedTool": "currentDateTimeTool",
"baseUrl": "https://api.example.com"

// CORRECT:
"agentSelectedTool": "currentDateTime",
"apiBase": "https://api.example.com",
"agentSelectedToolRequiresHumanInput": ""  // empty string, NOT false
prevention: Reference STANDARD_TOOLS.md for exact field names
agentSelectedToolRequiresHumanInput must be empty string
apiBase not baseUrl for custom HTTP tools
currentDateTime not currentDateTimeTool

common_issues.description: Workflow missing mandatory Start node, preventing user input
symptoms: Workflow loads in Flowise but cannot be triggered
No intake form for user input
First node is Router instead of Start
AgentFlow v2 won't execute
common_issues.root_cause: Architect assumed existing implementation and omitted Start node specification. Builder followed architecture faithfully without Start node.
common_issues.solution: Every AgentFlow v2 workflow MUST begin with a Start node containing formTitle, formDescription, and formInputTypes
prevention: Architect MUST specify Node 0: Start Node in architecture.md
Validate Start node exists in Test phase
Check Start node has all 3 required inputs
Verify Start node connects to Router or first agent

common_issues.description: Agent nodes not connected to any edges, appearing as orphans
symptoms: Flowise validation warning: 'Not connected to anything'
Agent exists in nodes array but no edges reference it
Router has scenarios without matching agents
Workflow runs but skips certain agents
common_issues.root_cause: Number of ConditionAgent scenarios does not match number of downstream agents. Scenario count must equal agent count.
common_issues.solution: Ensure every scenario in Router connects to exactly one agent. Verify edges array includes connections for all agents.
common_issues.code_fix:
// If Router has 4 scenarios, must have 4 downstream agents:
"scenarios": [
  {"scenario": "billing", ...},  // → billingAgent
  {"scenario": "technical", ...}, // → techAgent  
  {"scenario": "general", ...},   // → generalAgent
  {"scenario": "clarify", ...}    // → clarifyAgent
]
prevention: Count scenarios and verify equal number of agents
Check edges array has entry for each scenario→agent
Run Flowise validation before deployment
Use Pattern #4 prevention checklist

common_issues.description: Agent references tools that don't exist in Flowise
symptoms: Agent fails with 'tool not found' error
Invented tool names in agentTools array
Tools reference external systems not configured
Knowledge bases referenced but not created
common_issues.root_cause: Builder hallucinated tool names instead of using actual Flowise tool names from STANDARD_TOOLS.md
common_issues.solution: Only reference tools that exist in Flowise. Use exact names: Calculator, WebBrowser, customHttpTool, etc.
prevention: Reference STANDARD_TOOLS.md for available tools
Use customHttpTool for external APIs
Validate all tool names against Flowise registry
Don't invent tool names that might exist

common_issues.description: ConditionAgent has scenarios array but missing required fields
symptoms: Router node visible but scenario fields blank in UI
ConditionAgent routes incorrectly
scenarios array exists but entries incomplete
Missing model, instructions, or input fields
common_issues.root_cause: Scenarios array present but entries only have scenario name. Must have complete structure with model, instructions, input.
common_issues.solution: Each scenario MUST have: scenario (string), model (string), instructions (string), input (string)
prevention: Use complete scenario template from Pattern #7
Validate all 4 fields present in each scenario
Test ConditionAgent routing in isolation
Check scenarios array structure in Test phase

common_issues.description: Workflow missing required WORKFLOW-DIAGRAM.md with Mermaid visualization
symptoms: No WORKFLOW-DIAGRAM.md file generated
Mermaid generator not executed
Documentation incomplete without visual diagram
Build passes but lacks required documentation
common_issues.root_cause: mermaid_generator.py not executed in Documentation phase. This is a blocking requirement for Flowise projects.
common_issues.solution: Run mermaid_generator.py to create WORKFLOW-DIAGRAM.md with embedded Mermaid diagram
prevention: Documentation phase must run mermaid_generator.py
Validate WORKFLOW-DIAGRAM.md exists before deployment
Check diagram contains all nodes from workflow
Verify Mermaid syntax renders correctly

common_issues.description: HIL (Human-in-the-Loop) gate has wrong inputParams structure
symptoms: HIL node appears but configuration incorrect
Approval flow doesn't work
Missing or extra fields in HIL inputParams
Type mismatches in HIL configuration
common_issues.root_cause: HIL gate requires exactly 5 inputParams fields with specific types. Wrong structure breaks approval workflow.
common_issues.solution: Use exact HIL gate structure from templates with 5 required fields
prevention: Reference HIL gate template for exact structure
Validate exactly 5 inputParams fields
Check field types match expected (string, options)
Test HIL approval/rejection flows

common_issues.description: HIL gate missing required inputParams fields entirely
symptoms: HIL node not editable in UI
Cannot configure approval messages
HIL gate exists but has empty inputParams
Template not fully copied
common_issues.root_cause: HIL gate created with empty or partial inputParams array. All 5 required fields must be present.
common_issues.solution: Copy complete HIL gate inputParams from template. Never create HIL with partial fields.
prevention: Always copy full HIL template
Validate inputParams length === 5
Test HIL node opens in Flowise UI
Check all field labels present

common_issues.description: Tool inclusion broken after modular prompt refactoring
symptoms: Agents created without tools
agentTools array empty or missing
Standard tools (Calculator, WebBrowser) not included
Prompt sections reorganized and tool instructions lost
common_issues.root_cause: Orchestrator prompt was refactored and tool inclusion instructions were moved or lost. Agents must include standard tools.
common_issues.solution: Every Flowise agent MUST include Calculator and WebBrowser tools in agentTools array
prevention: Verify standard tools in every agent node
Check agentTools array not empty
Reference STANDARD_TOOLS.md for tool structure
Validate in Test phase before deployment

common_issues.description: ConditionAgent uses wrong variable format in scenarios
symptoms: Router doesn't receive user input
Variables not resolved in scenario input
Plain text instead of variable syntax
Scenarios reference undefined variables
common_issues.root_cause: Using plain text or wrong syntax for state variables. Flowise requires {{variableName}} format.
common_issues.solution: Use {{variableName}} syntax for state variable references in scenario input fields
prevention: Always use double curly braces for variables
Check scenario input fields use {{}} syntax
Validate variable names match state keys
Test variable resolution in Router

common_issues.description: Node type field doesn't match actual node structure
symptoms: Node appears but wrong icon in Flowise
Configuration panel shows wrong fields
Type says 'Agent' but structure is ConditionAgent
Validation errors about unexpected fields
common_issues.root_cause: Node's type field doesn't match its data structure. type: 'Agent' must have Agent structure.
common_issues.solution: Ensure type field matches node structure: Agent, ConditionAgent, Start, humanInTheLoopAgentflow
prevention: Match type field to data.type
Use consistent casing (conditionAgent vs ConditionAgent)
Reference node templates for correct types
Validate type matches structure in Test phase

common_issues.description: Workflow has Start and Router but no processing agents
symptoms: Workflow has only 2-3 nodes
Start node connects to Router with no downstream
Router scenarios defined but agents missing
Incomplete node generation
common_issues.root_cause: Builder stopped after creating Start and Router. Specialized agents never generated.
common_issues.solution: Workflow must include Start node, Router, AND all specialized agents for each scenario
prevention: Verify node count matches architecture
Check all scenarios have corresponding agents
Validate edges connect all nodes
Count nodes: Start + Router + N agents
